correctness.rationale: For every prime-power field of characteristic greater than three, direct differentiation yields the rational Gauss coordinates. Exact elimination factors the competing-contact condition as a product of a zero root, the original-contact root and one linear residual factor. All pole and singular exceptions are enumerated. A centered-coordinate substitution breaks the singleton locus into six lines, an optional split quadratic and one rational cubic with disjoint admissible parts, giving exact residue-class formulas. Two standalone scripts passed, independently testing the identities and finite-field fibres.

value.rationale: The exact number of distinct rational tangent lines and rational-rational bitangents is a natural numerical refinement of a covering theorem: covering alone cannot quantify incidence redundancy. The uniform two-contact bound, explicit involution and closed formulas in every admissible field describe the rational Gauss-map image as a finite incidence configuration. The distinction by q modulo three has a clear geometric cause: the splitting of a quadratic exceptional locus. This is not merely a finite census or a routine reformulation of tangent filling.
